mtls_mode.title: mTLS Mode
mtls_mode.description: The mutual TLS mode enforced across the service mesh for service-to-service communication. STRICT requires valid client certificates on all connections; PERMISSIVE allows both plaintext and mTLS; DISABLED allows only plaintext.

mesh_wide_policy_enforced.title: Mesh-Wide mTLS Policy Enforced
mesh_wide_policy_enforced.description: Indicates whether a mesh-wide or namespace-wide policy enforces mTLS rather than relying solely on per-service policies, ensuring no service is accidentally left unenforced.

certificate_authority_configured.title: Certificate Authority Configured
certificate_authority_configured.description: Indicates whether a certificate authority (CA) is actively configured and issuing workload certificates for cryptographic identity binding within the service mesh.

workload_identity_provider.title: Workload Identity Provider
workload_identity_provider.description: The identity system used to issue cryptographic credentials to service workloads, determining whether strong, verifiable identities are assigned to each service principal.

service_account_token_projection_enabled.title: Service Account Token Projection Enabled
service_account_token_projection_enabled.description: Whether projected service account tokens (bound to audience and TTL) are used to cryptographically bind workload identity to service requests, rather than relying on static or shared credentials.

authorization_policies_deployed.title: Authorization Policies Deployed
authorization_policies_deployed.description: Whether AuthorizationPolicy resources (or equivalent) are deployed in the service mesh that restrict service-to-service calls based on source principal identity.

policy_granularity_level.title: Policy Granularity Level
policy_granularity_level.description: The finest level of access control enforced in authorization policies between services.

default_deny_policy_present.title: Default Deny Policy Present
default_deny_policy_present.description: Whether a default-deny AuthorizationPolicy or equivalent exists to block all traffic not explicitly permitted.

source_principal_binding_enforced.title: Source Principal Binding Enforced
source_principal_binding_enforced.description: Whether authorization policies bind access rules to cryptographic service identities (e.g., SPIFFE/SVID, service account) rather than IP addresses or labels alone.

authorization_policy_mode.title: Authorization Policy Enforcement Mode
authorization_policy_mode.description: The enforcement mode of the service-level authorization policy controlling which service principals may invoke protected endpoints.

pre_execution_enforcement_point.title: Pre-Execution Enforcement Point
pre_execution_enforcement_point.description: Where credential and authorization checks are enforced relative to request processing — must occur before business logic executes to constitute prevention rather than detection.

auth_event_logging_enabled.title: Authentication Event Logging Enabled
auth_event_logging_enabled.description: Whether structured audit logging is enabled for all authentication attempts (both success and failure) across service mesh boundaries.

logged_fields_coverage.title: Logged Fields Coverage
logged_fields_coverage.description: Indicates which required fields are captured in authentication event logs: service identity, target service, timestamp, and policy outcome.

failure_events_captured.title: Authentication Failure Events Captured
failure_events_captured.description: Whether authentication failure events (rejected or unauthorized service calls) are explicitly logged in addition to successful authentications.

ca_integration_enabled.title: CA Integration Enabled
ca_integration_enabled.description: Whether the service mesh or workload identity system is integrated with a PKI or certificate authority for automated certificate issuance.

automatic_rotation_configured.title: Automatic Certificate Rotation Configured
automatic_rotation_configured.description: Whether service certificates are configured for automated rotation before expiry without manual intervention.

revocation_propagation_mechanism.title: Revocation Propagation Mechanism
revocation_propagation_mechanism.description: The mechanism used to propagate certificate revocation to service mesh proxies or workloads.

authorization_policies_version_controlle.title: Authorization Policies Version Controlled
authorization_policies_version_controlle.description: Whether authorization policies are stored in a version control system (e.g., Git) rather than applied ad-hoc or managed through UI-only interfaces.

cicd_pipeline_enforces_policy_deployment.title: CI/CD Pipeline Enforces Policy Deployment
cicd_pipeline_enforces_policy_deployment.description: Whether authorization policies are deployed exclusively through an automated CI/CD pipeline rather than through manual kubectl/API applies or direct cluster access.

policy_testing_integrated_in_pipeline.title: Policy Testing Integrated in Pipeline
policy_testing_integrated_in_pipeline.description: Whether automated policy validation or unit tests (e.g., OPA conftest, Rego unit tests, policy linting) are executed as part of the CI/CD pipeline before deployment.

baseline_communication_graph_defined.title: Baseline Communication Graph Defined
baseline_communication_graph_defined.description: Indicates whether an expected service-to-service communication graph (allowed peer relationships) has been formally defined and is actively used for anomaly detection.

anomaly_detection_mode.title: Anomaly Detection Mode
anomaly_detection_mode.description: The operational mode of the anomalous call pattern detection system — whether it is actively enforcing, only monitoring/alerting, or disabled.

auth_event_correlation_enabled.title: Auth Event Correlation Enabled
auth_event_correlation_enabled.description: Indicates whether authentication and authorization events from the service mesh are being collected and correlated against the expected communication graph in real time or near-real time.
